title: Abelianness and small colimits in functor categories
statement: Let $J$ be a $\mathcal U$-small category and let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with all $\mathcal U$-small colimits. The category $\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal A)$ of functors and natural transformations is abelian and has all $\mathcal U$-small colimits. Colimits and their structure maps are as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; a coproduct is the colimit of the discrete diagram of its summands.
